SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.sale_date IS NOT NULL THEN fsl.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_sold,
    SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) AS units_returned
FROM dim_product p
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON p.product_key = fsl.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
  AND p.is_current = TRUE
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY p.subcategory;

-- Get sales in Q1 FY2024/25 for Garden products
WITH garden_sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.quantity,
    fsl.product_key
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
    AND p.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
)
SELECT 
  gs.subcategory,
  SUM(gs.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(gs.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM garden_sales_q1 gs
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON gs.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
GROUP BY gs.subcategory
ORDER BY gs.subcategory;

-- Check for sales with null product_key or member_key issues in Q1 FY2024/25
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_product_key,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_fiscal_year
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1;

-- Check Garden returns to see if all link to valid sales
WITH garden_sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT fsl.sales_line_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
    AND p.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_garden_returns_linked_to_q1_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN frl.quantity_returned IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_quantity
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN garden_sales_q1 gs ON frl.sales_line_id = gs.sales_line_id;

-- Verify total units returned
WITH garden_sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT fsl.sales_line_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
    AND p.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
)
SELECT 
  SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as total_units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN garden_sales_q1 gs ON frl.sales_line_id = gs.sales_line_id;

-- Final query: Return rate by Garden subcategory for Q1 FY2024/25 goods
WITH garden_sales_q1 AS (
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' 
    AND p.is_current = TRUE
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
)
SELECT 
  gs.subcategory,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(gs.quantity), 2) AS return_rate
FROM garden_sales_q1 gs
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON gs.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
GROUP BY gs.subcategory
ORDER BY gs.subcategory;
